comments.body: Hi! I've been placed on a waiting list, so I don't have an outright rejection but neither am I offered an interview. I believe the LSZGS selection committee is contacting their top applicants, and waiting to hear back if they accept interviews or not before they move down the list. Do you have any insights on how many applicants are added to the waiting list, or just any insights that can help me estimate my current chances? Thank you!
comments.author: the-medium-cheese
